explicit_nonselection.BTCUSD: CURRENT_MINIMUM_VOLUME_MARGIN_EXCEEDS_EUR200; do not synthesize a smaller volume.
explicit_nonselection.US500_NAS100: Existing baseline and frozen C013-C016 remain available as later portfolio/context components, but the first new competition frontier deliberately does not create more index-only variants.
explicit_nonselection.STANDARD_US_SHARES: Technically feasible examples exist, but intraday candidate-independent cost/commission evidence and limited cash-session coverage make them a later frontier, not the first broad-time-coverage wave.
explicit_nonselection.EXTENDED_HOURS_SHARES_AND_OTHER_SYMBOLS: Persisted accepted evidence lacks exhaustive minimum-volume ExpectedMargin; keep unresolved until the one generic broker-universe capture closes this current-fact gap.

resolution_decision.why: M15 is chosen only for this first frontier to obtain competition-relevant opportunity density across broad sessions while avoiding an immediate M1/M5 noise/cost burden. Existing D1/H1/H4 data are too coarse for the first density screen.

prospective_mechanism_scope.rule: This is a bounded mechanism pool, not a parameter grid. Exact economic identities must be prospectively frozen before their first outcomes are opened.

first_economic_wave_identity_budget.purpose: Broad first-pass information gathering across distinct market/mechanism contexts, not threshold/lookback spam.
